comments.author: Markus Kremer
comments.comment:
Agent harnesses can cost more in tokens than the model itself, especially when pre-loaded with 25 tools.

Your test shows a 6x token overhead between frameworks on the same idle task. That's a tax paid before any real work begins.

For my production evals, I now treat the agent framework as a first-class hyperparameter. The cheapest model with a bloated harness can lose to a pricier one with a lean setup.

How do you measure and trim your framework's token overhead before scaling?

comments.author: Skander Ben Mahmoud
comments.comment: Agentic workflows break without review loops. Your plugin tackles the context-preservation problem head-on. Does threading each comment to its exact text anchor improve the agent's correction accuracy in practice, or does it just organize the noise better?
